name: Confast Block Fix
shortDescription: A ready-to-mix, self-curing cementitious mortar specially designed for mounting various blocks, bricks and masonry units with superior bond strength.
fullDescription: Confast Block Fix is a premium, ready-to-use, single-component cementitious mortar engineered for the mounting of AAC blocks, CLC blocks, fly ash bricks, and natural stone blocks. Its polymer-modified formula ensures excellent workability, minimal shrinkage, and outstanding adhesion to both block faces, making it the preferred choice of professional builders and contractors across India.
features: Self-curing formula reduces water curing effort
Excellent bond strength with all masonry units
benefits: Works with AAC, CLC, fly ash and clay bricks
coverage: 4–5 kg per sq.m at 10 mm thickness

faqs.question: What is the water-powder ratio for Block Fix?
faqs.answer: Mix 1 part water to approximately 5.3 parts Block Fix powder by weight (0.17–0.19 water/powder ratio). Add water to powder, never the reverse.

faqs.question: Can Block Fix be used for exterior block laying?
faqs.answer: Yes, Confast Block Fix is suitable for both interior and exterior masonry work. Ensure joints are protected from rain for the first 24 hours.

faqs.question: What joint thickness is recommended?
faqs.answer: An optimal joint thickness of 6–10 mm is recommended for best performance and material efficiency.

name: Confast TileSet 11
shortDescription: A single component, professional cement-based powder adhesive for fixing wall and floor tiles in dry interior areas.
fullDescription: Confast TileSet 11 is a single-component, cement-based tile adhesive classified as C1TE (Type 1 with extended open time). It is engineered for fixing ceramic, vitrified, and mosaic tiles on interior walls and floors in normal dry conditions. The formulation ensures smooth application, excellent grab, and reliable long-term bond strength, meeting IS 15477 standards.
features: Extended open time for easy tile adjustment
benefits: Easy to use for contractors and applicators
coverage: 3.5–4.5 kg per sq.m at 6 mm notch

faqs.question: Which tiles is TileSet 11 suitable for?
faqs.answer: TileSet 11 is ideal for ceramic, porcelain, and mosaic tiles up to 30×30 cm on interior walls and floors.

faqs.question: Can TileSet 11 be used in wet areas like bathrooms?
faqs.answer: TileSet 11 is designed for dry interior areas. For wet areas like bathrooms and kitchens, we recommend TileSet 33 or TileSet 44.

name: Confast TileSet 22
shortDescription: A high polymer-modified, cement-based wall and floor tile adhesive with improved adhesion strength for demanding applications.
fullDescription: Confast TileSet 22 is a high-performance, polymer-modified, single-component tile adhesive classified as C2T (Type 2). It delivers enhanced adhesion, improved flexibility, and superior workability over standard C1 adhesives. Suitable for larger format tiles, vitrified surfaces, and moderately wet areas, TileSet 22 represents the next step in tiling quality.
features: High polymer modification for superior bond
Good resistance to water after curing
Suitable for larger format tiles (up to 60×60 cm)
benefits: Suitable for interior wet and dry areas
Works on AAC block, cement plaster, concrete substrates
coverage: 4–5 kg per sq.m at 6 mm notch

faqs.question: What size tiles can TileSet 22 handle?
faqs.answer: TileSet 22 is suitable for tiles up to 60×60 cm. For larger format tiles (80×80 cm and above), we recommend TileSet 33 or TileSet 44.

faqs.question: Is TileSet 22 suitable for swimming pools?
faqs.answer: For swimming pools, we recommend the epoxy-based Epoxy 77 or TileSet 44 with additional waterproofing. TileSet 22 is not recommended for fully submerged applications.

name: Confast TileSet 33
shortDescription: A highly polymer-modified, flexible wall and floor tile adhesive for demanding structural and wet area applications.
fullDescription: Confast TileSet 33 is a premium, highly polymer-modified, single-component tile adhesive classified as C2TE (Type 3 with extended open time). Designed for professional and demanding applications, it offers outstanding flexibility, superior bond strength, and excellent resistance to water and thermal movement. It is the product of choice for large format tiles, exterior facades, and swimming pools.
features: S1 deformability class — handles structural movement
Outstanding bond on vitrified and polished surfaces
Suitable for exterior facades and wet areas
Long open time for precise tile work
benefits: Prevents tile cracking due to structural movement
Suitable for natural stone and heavy tiles
applications: Large Format Tiles (80×80 cm and above)
coverage: 4.5–6 kg per sq.m at 8 mm notch

faqs.question: Can TileSet 33 be used on exterior facades?
faqs.answer: Yes, TileSet 33 is specifically engineered for exterior facade applications where thermal movement and weather exposure demand a flexible, durable adhesive.

faqs.question: What is the maximum tile size TileSet 33 can support?
faqs.answer: TileSet 33 can handle large format tiles up to 120×60 cm. For extremely heavy natural stone, additional mechanical fixing may be recommended.

name: Confast TileSet 44
tagline: Type 3 S1 Super Flex Premium Tile Adhesive
shortDescription: The most advanced, super-flexible premium tile adhesive with S1 deformability for the most demanding professional applications.
fullDescription: Confast TileSet 44 is CONFAST's flagship tile adhesive — a C2TES1 classified, super-flexible, polymer-fortified adhesive that delivers unmatched bond strength and deformability. Engineered for the most challenging tiling scenarios including large-format porcelain slabs, exterior cladding, swimming pools, and thermally stressed substrates, TileSet 44 is the professional installer's ultimate choice.
features: Super S1 deformability — maximum movement absorption
Outstanding adhesion on vitrified, porcelain, glass tiles
Suitable for all substrates including screed and render
Maximum open time for precise positioning
benefits: Handles heavy building movement with ease
Perfect for premium projects requiring guarantees
Trusted by leading architects and contractors
coverage: 5–7 kg per sq.m at 8–10 mm notch

faqs.question: What makes TileSet 44 different from TileSet 33?
faqs.answer: TileSet 44 carries the S1 deformability classification, meaning it can accommodate greater substrate movement (≥ 2.5 mm) without causing tile failure. It is the top-of-the-range product for premium and critical applications.

faqs.question: Is TileSet 44 suitable for glass mosaic tiles?
faqs.answer: Yes, TileSet 44 white variant is specifically recommended for glass mosaic tiles due to its high bond strength and white colour that preserves tile aesthetics.

name: Confast Epoxy 77
shortDescription: A three-component, epoxy resin-based premium grout for internal and external tile joints with exceptional chemical and stain resistance.
fullDescription: Confast Epoxy 77 is a 3-component epoxy grout system comprising Epoxy Resin (Part A), Epoxy Hardener (Part B), and Fine Filler (Part C). It forms an extremely hard, dense, impervious joint that is highly resistant to chemicals, staining, and heavy traffic. Ideal for pharmaceutical, food processing, swimming pools, and any area requiring hygienic, easy-to-clean grout joints.
features: Zero water absorption — completely waterproof joint
benefits: Hygienic — bacteria and mould resistant joints
Ideal for sterile and clean-room environments
Resistant to cleaning chemicals and disinfectants
coverage: Approx. 700–900 gm per sq.m for 3 mm joint

faqs.question: Is Epoxy 77 suitable for swimming pools?
faqs.answer: Yes, Confast Epoxy 77 is one of the best choices for swimming pools due to its zero water absorption, chemical resistance, and permanent colour stability.

faqs.question: How many colours are available in Epoxy 77?
faqs.answer: Epoxy 77 is available in 14 standard shades. Custom shades may be available for bulk orders — please contact our technical team.

faqs.question: What is the pot life of Epoxy 77?
faqs.answer: The pot life is approximately 45 minutes at 25°C. In higher temperatures, the pot life reduces. It is advisable to mix small quantities for manageable working time.

name: Confast SBR Latex+
tagline: Premium SBR Polymer for Repair & Bonding
shortDescription: A premium SBR (Styrene Butadiene Rubber) latex bonding additive that dramatically improves the properties of render, screed, mortar, and repair mixes.
fullDescription: Confast SBR Latex+ is a specially modified, milky-white SBR polymer emulsion designed to be added to cement-based mortars, renders, screeds, and repair mixes. It significantly enhances bond strength, flexibility, durability, and water resistance of the mix. Acting as both a bonding agent (slurry coat) and an admixture, SBR Latex+ is a versatile construction chemical trusted by waterproofing specialists, structural repair contractors, and civil engineers.
features: Dramatically improves bond strength of mortars
Excellent waterproofing properties when used as slurry
Acts as bonding bridge between old and new concrete
Compatible with all cement and sand mixes
benefits: Multi-purpose: bonding agent + admixture in one
Reduces risk of delamination in repairs
Extends service life of repaired structures
Easy to use — no special tools required
coverage: 0.2–0.3 litres per sq.m as slurry coat

faqs.question: Can SBR Latex+ be used for waterproofing terraces?
faqs.answer: Yes, SBR Latex+ mixed with cement as a slurry coat is a proven method for terrace and roof waterproofing. For critical applications, consult our technical team for a complete system specification.

faqs.question: What is the mixing ratio for using it as a bonding agent?
faqs.answer: For a bonding slurry, mix 1 part SBR Latex+ with 1 part cement and apply as a slurry coat. For mortar modification, add SBR at 10–15% of the water content.
